pap_hero_intro: Wilfrido Ortega (26 Oktober 1932 – 26 Mei 2026) a dediká su mes na skibi i publiká buki na Papiamentu. Su produktividatnan, su forma di imprimí i su distribushon di porta pa porta ta e temanan ku e website aki ta eksplorá.
en_hero_intro: Wilfrido Ortega (26 October 1932 – 26 May 2026) devoted himself to writing and publishing books in Papiamentu. This website explores his works, his printing methods, and his door-to-door distribution.
pap_destino_description: E promé manuskrito di Destino di Amor tabata tin 500 pagina. Riba rekomendashon di Otto Zalm, Wilfrido a redusí e paginanan na sesenta pa baha gastu di imprenta.
en_destino_description: The first manuscript of Destino di Amor contained 500 pages. On Otto Zalm’s recommendation, Wilfrido reduced it to sixty pages to lower printing costs.
